arguments.premise_synthesis: One hedge fund already owned about half of the available shares. Another hedge fund bought up all other available shares and used options to guarantee delivery. When they exercised options, it forced the other side to deliver shares that did not exist in the open market, driving up the price and trapping short sellers.
